freeze_record.reason: operationalize restricted interactions, bind clean causal controls, and isolate explicit pairing

seed_policy.formula: base + family_order_index * 10000 + replicate * 100000 + task_index where a task component applies
seed_policy.condition_pairing: all conditions use identical non-label seeds for a family/task/replicate

tie_breakers: minimum worst-family median restricted interactions to exact optimum with failures at 8193
minimum macro-average family median restricted interactions

restricted_interactions_metric.success_value: post-hoc cumulative paid-probe plus candidate-generation actions through the first exact candidate in generation order
restricted_interactions_metric.failure_value: endpoint_adaptation_actions + 1 reporting sentinel, regardless of partial executed action count
restricted_interactions_metric.oracle_timing: generate the complete declared fixed batch, independently replay it, then query the exact optimum and classify the first exact candidate; the oracle never changes search control flow
restricted_interactions_metric.family_aggregation: compute success rate and median restricted interactions within each family first, then give families equal weight
restricted_interactions_metric.typed_record_requirement: successful units must carry first_optimum_adaptation_actions as a validated typed field before comparative screening

capacity_matching.same_data_controls: identical backbone, head, trainable parameter count, optimizer, updates, batches, inference and search budgets
capacity_matching.strong_optimum_baseline: run optimum imitation on the same selected backbone and capacity band as every improvement-aware contender
capacity_matching.optimum_training_compute: must not be lower than the matched improvement-aware contender

fixed_defaults.unknown_affordance_policy: zero feature with eligible uniform fallback

destroyed_structure_controls.pooled: multi-structure control: same transitions with cross-trajectory pairing, sequence order and better-stage labels absent
destroyed_structure_controls.pairing_only_unpaired: same frontier and optimum trajectories, sequence order, stage labels and example multiset as F; remove only cross-trajectory pair membership while keeping F capacity, optimizer, training, inference and search budgets
destroyed_structure_controls.randomized_direction: independent fair-coin better-side label for every pair using the frozen label seed; no intentionally correct subset
destroyed_structure_controls.randomized_pairing: seeded within-stratum derangement of optimum partners with no self-pairs, preserving every individual trajectory and label marginal; use the same identical exclusions as F and report them
destroyed_structure_controls.shuffled_history: same transition multiset and pair membership with within-sequence order permuted

control_seed_identity_requirements.all_controls: bind the control identifier and every transformation parameter to the condition and training-data artifact identity

pairing_only_unpaired.seed: no additional randomization; inherit F's non-label seeds
pairing_only_unpaired.trajectory_identity: exactly the same frontier and optimum trajectories as F
pairing_only_unpaired.examples: same example identities, count and multiset as F
pairing_only_unpaired.learner_visible_membership_metadata: none; serialized learner examples must exclude trajectory-pair IDs, alignment-pair IDs, shared record keys, and any other field that can reconstruct pair membership

randomized_direction.identity_binding: bind the seed and realized direction-map hash to the condition and training-data artifact identity

randomized_pairing.randomization: seeded derangement within compatible alignment strata
randomized_pairing.exclusions: identical compatible-strata exclusions to F and reported
randomized_pairing.identity_binding: bind the seed, realized pairing-map hash and exclusions to the condition and training-data artifact identity

pooled.identity_binding: bind pooled control kind to the condition and training-data artifact identity

representation_ladder_questions: Does state conditioning help beyond global/action-only statistics?
Does transition information help beyond current state?
Does history/sequence help beyond transition information?
Does explicit frontier-to-optimum pairing help beyond the exact same trajectories without pair membership?

state_conditioning.claim_scope: state-conditioned current-observation features beyond global affordance features under matched data, objective, updates, seeds, and search budget

transition_information.required_match: same trajectories, examples, objective, capacity band, seeds, optimizer, updates, inference budget, and search budget; transition-only must be compared with state-only

history_sequence.required_match: same trajectories, transitions, examples, objective, capacity band, seeds, optimizer, updates, inference budget, and search budget; history/sequence must be compared with transition-only

alignment_contract.unmatched_policy: retain as unmatched; never force a nearest match
alignment_contract.randomized_pairing: derange within compatible alignment strata; strata without a valid derangement are excluded identically from F and E2 and reported
